stories.title: Data center backlash hasn't turned into a full climate reckoning yet

The piece says current backlash focuses on local power and water use rather than emissions overall. It calls for more attention to the climate side of the data center boom.
stories.whyItMatters: AI's data center buildout is straining power grids and water supplies, making its climate footprint a growing industry and policy issue.
